name: Altar Society
tagline: Serving the Altar, Serving the Parish
description:
All lady’s from our parish ages 18+ are members. We meet the first Sunday of the month; unless its a holiday then we have the meeting on the second Sunday of the month. Not only do we serve funerals. We make sure the kitchen is supplied, Priests vestment and altar items are taken care of. Please join us!

The Altar Society is a long-standing tradition at Saint Thérèse, where the women of the parish care for the sacred linens, altar vessels, flowers, and decorations of our church. It is a beautiful way to serve the Lord through care of His house.
